description: Mailing-list search, keyword (BM25 over the authors' own words) and semantic (embeddings) blended per thread, over every list unless inbox names one or more. Returns up to limit threads (default 20, max 50), best first, each its best message: inbox, message_id, subject, from, date, thread_id, fused_score (0-1), similarity and a short excerpt of the author's own words. Like a ranked `git log --grep` for mail. Cite as https://postgr.es/m/<message_id>; read with get_thread or get_message (inbox from the result). author, since and until restrict both arms to one sender and a date window. Takes search's operators. Echoes operators applied, warnings for dropped ones, skipped if mail is excluded; a query that cannot run is an error. complete=false when the keyword arm ran out of budget_ms or a total is a lower bound.

author.description: Only messages this person sent: a name, an e-mail address or hash:<8 hex> (a person page). Resolved to every address they post from; an ambiguous name returns the candidates to choose from.

budget_ms.description: Time budget in ms for the keyword search (100-15000; default 4500, the engine's own limits). complete=false in the reply when it ran out or a total is a lower bound.

inbox.description: Lists to search: omit (or "all") for every list, the default; one name such as pgsql-bugs; or several, comma-separated ("pgsql-hackers,pgsql-bugs"). Names from list_inboxes. Aliases: list, inbox_name.

keyword_weight.description: Weight for keyword results in the fusion, 0.0-1.0 (default 0.65). Raise it for exact identifiers (function names, GUCs, error text); lower it to lean on semantic similarity.

query.description: Search query (supports both keywords and natural language). Operators: after:/before:YYYY[-MM[-DD]], d:A..B, site:<list|docs|wiki|commits>, from:/author:, intitle:/s:, intext:/b:, to:/cc:, filetype:patch, has:patch, link:<url glob> (messages linking to a URL; link:example.org = any URL on that host), /regex/ (case:yes for case-sensitive), -operator to negate. Operators without words list matches newest first.

since.description: Only messages sent on or after this date (UTC): YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, an ISO date-time, or 2w / 6m / 1y ago.

until.description: Only messages sent before this date (exclusive), same forms as since. With author: what that person had said by then.

name: hybrid_search
